conflict_resolutions.RELATIONAL_LEADS_WITHOUT_TARGET_STATUS_O: The only lead was the OFR editorial supersession edge from EO 9209 (a relation without a status observation). I read the held Federal Register text of EO 9209 myself: its sentence naming EO 5866 by number and date says it is superseded, effective as of June 1, 1942. The status rests on that text and the order's own terms, not on the editorial edge.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 9209 (7 FR 6029, August 5, 1942) states "are hereby superseded." of Executive Orders No. 3705-A and "and No. 5866 of June 28, 1932," and takes effect as of June 1, 1942, re-prescribing the same five classes and amounts. The order is a standing pay rule with no own-terms end; no earlier end was found in the held corpus; the supersession is whole-order, so there is no partial scope; no saving clause appears. Not operative on 2026-10-14.
